name: iro
description: IRO - Indian Republic Org | Civic + Political Digital Infrastructure Platform

scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n api,admin-api,admin-web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin-api" "npm run dev:admin-web"
scripts.install:services: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix iro-admin-service && npm install --prefix admin-web
scripts.docker:up:admin-web: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml --profile ui up --build -d admin-web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
